record.paper_title: Open problems for tractability of multivariate integration
record.original_question: For randomized integration in the weighted Sobolev Hilbert space on [0,1]^d with kernel product_{j=1}^d (1 + gamma_j min(x_j,t_j)) and positive nonincreasing weights gamma_j, is sum gamma_j^2 finite a necessary condition for strong tractability?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d\ge 1$ and let $\gamma=(\gamma_j)_{j\ge 1}$ be a sequence of positive, nonincreasing weights. Consider the weighted Sobolev reproducing kernel Hilbert space $H_{d,\gamma}$ of real-valued functions on $[0,1]^d$ associated with the product kernel
$$K_{d,\gamma}(x,t)=\prod_{j=1}^{d} igl(1+\gamma_j\min(x_j,t_j) igr),\qquad x,t\in[0,1]^d.$$
For a randomized algorithm $A_{n,d}$ using at most $n$ function values, define its randomized worst-case error for approximating the integral $I_d(f)=\int_{[0,1]^d} f(x)\,dx$ by
$$e^{\mathrm{ran}}(A_{n,d})=\sup_{\|f\|_{H_{d,\gamma}}\le 1} igl(\mathbb{E}|I_d(f)-A_{n,d}(f)|^2 igr)^{1/2},$$
and let $e^{\mathrm{ran}}(n,d)=\inf_{A_{n,d}} e^{\mathrm{ran}}(A_{n,d})$ denote the $n$-th minimal randomized error. The integration problem is called \emph{strongly tractable} in the randomized setting if there exist constants $C>0$ and $p>0$, independent of $d$, such that
$$e^{\mathrm{ran}}(n,d)\le C\,n^{-p}\qquad	ext{for all }n,d\ge 1.$$

Question: Is the condition $\sum_{j=1}^{\infty}\gamma_j^{2}<\infty$ a necessary condition for randomized strong tractability of multivariate integration in the spaces $\{H_{d,\gamma}\}_{d\ge 1}$?
artifact.status_search_result: A direct resolution of this specific necessity question for randomized strong tractability with the kernel $\prod_j(1+\gamma_j\min(x_j,t_j))$ was not located. Related work establishes sufficient conditions (e.g., involving $\sum \log\gamma_j$ or bounded partial sums) but the precise necessity of $\sum \gamma_j^2<\infty$ does not appear to be confirmed in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Multivariate integration in weighted Hilbert spaces based on Walsh functions and weighted Sobolev spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Conditions on the weights gamma_j for strong tractability and tractability of multivariate integration are studied.
status_evidence.claim: Related sufficient/necessary conditions on weights are discussed but do not settle the specific question for the randomized setting with this kernel.

status_evidence.title: Tractability of Integration in Non-periodic and Periodic Weighted Tensor Product Hilbert Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies tractability of integration in weighted tensor product Hilbert spaces with conditions on weights.
status_evidence.claim: Provides framework for tractability but does not resolve the necessity of sum gamma_j^2<infinity for randomized strong tractability.
